## Controller board parts

| Ref | Part | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| U1 | ESP32-DevKitC-32E | controller (Espressif, ESP32-WROOM-32E, 38 pin) |
| U2 | Pololu D24V22F5 | 5 V 2.5 A step-down regulator |
| U3 | BTT TMC2209 V1.3 | stepper driver (UART mode) |
| U4 | SN74AHCT125N | 3.3 V -> 5 V buffer for the LED data (DIP-14 in a socket) |
| Q1 | 2N3904 | NPN, switches the START ring LED |
| F1 | Littelfuse RXEF200 | 2.0 A resettable fuse (PTC) |
| D1 | 1N5822 | 3 A Schottky: reverse-polarity protection |
| D2 | P6KE18A | 18 V TVS: clamps plug-in spikes on the 12 V rail |
| D3 | 1N5817 | 1 A Schottky: stops USB back-feeding the LED rail |
| C1 | 220 uF 35 V | electrolytic, 12 V bulk at the driver (low ESR) |
| C2 | 470 uF 16 V | electrolytic, 5 V LED rail reservoir |
| C3 | 100 nF | ceramic, U4 supply decoupling |
| C4 | 10 nF | ceramic, hall input filter |
| C5 | 100 nF | ceramic, speed knob filter |
| R1 | 1 k | TMC2209 single-wire UART (TX side) |
| R3 | 10 k | keeps the driver OFF until the firmware enables it |
| R4 | 330 | LED data A series resistor |
| R5 | 330 | LED data B series resistor |
| R6 | 10 k | hall sensor pull-up |
| R7 | 1 k | Q1 base |
| R8 | 100 k | Q1 base pull-down (ring LED off during boot) |
| J1 | JST XH 2-pin | POWER in (from the rocker switch) |
| J2 | JST XH 4-pin | MOTOR |
| J3 | JST XH 3-pin | HALL sensor |
| J4 | JST XH 3-pin | LED strip bank A (cylinders 1-5) |
| J5 | JST XH 3-pin | LED strip bank B (cylinders 6-10) |
| J6 | JST XH 3-pin | SPEED knob |
| J7 | JST XH 4-pin | START button + ring LED |

## Harnesses

**W1 POWER (rear panel)** - to 12 V DC jack (panel), illuminated rocker switch, cut length 250 mm

| From | To | Colour | AWG | Signal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| DC jack centre pin (+12 V) | rocker IN terminal | red | 20 | +12 V unswitched |
| rocker OUT terminal | J1-1 | red | 20 | +12 V switched |
| DC jack sleeve (GND) | J1-2 | black | 20 | ground |
| DC jack sleeve (GND) | rocker LAMP terminal | black | 22 | rocker lamp return |

**W2 MOTOR** - to NEMA17 17HS4401S, cut length 350 mm

| From | To | Colour | AWG | Signal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| J2-1 | motor black (A+) | black | 24 | coil A |
| J2-2 | motor green (A-) | green | 24 | coil A |
| J2-3 | motor red (B+) | red | 24 | coil B |
| J2-4 | motor blue (B-) | blue | 24 | coil B |

**W3 HALL** - to DRV5033AJQLPG hall switch (TO-92), cut length 200 mm

| From | To | Colour | AWG | Signal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| J3-1 | sensor pin 1 VCC | red | 26 | 3.3 V |
| J3-2 | sensor pin 2 GND | black | 26 | ground |
| J3-3 | sensor pin 3 OUT | white | 26 | LOW = magnet |

**W4 LED BANK A** - to WS2812B strip, 15 LEDs, head A, cut length 550 mm

| From | To | Colour | AWG | Signal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| J4-1 | strip +5V pad (data-in end) | red | 24 | 5 V |
| J4-2 | strip GND pad | black | 24 | ground |
| J4-3 | strip DIN pad | green | 24 | LED data |

**W5 LED BANK B** - to WS2812B strip, 15 LEDs, head B, cut length 550 mm

| From | To | Colour | AWG | Signal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| J5-1 | strip +5V pad (data-in end) | red | 24 | 5 V |
| J5-2 | strip GND pad | black | 24 | ground |
| J5-3 | strip DIN pad | green | 24 | LED data |

**W6 SPEED KNOB** - to 10 k linear pot, M7 bushing, cut length 250 mm

| From | To | Colour | AWG | Signal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| J6-1 | pot terminal 3 (clockwise end) | red | 26 | 3.3 V |
| J6-2 | pot terminal 2 (wiper) | yellow | 26 | speed signal |
| J6-3 | pot terminal 1 (counter-clockwise end) | black | 26 | ground |

**W7 START** - to 16 mm momentary button, 12 V ring LED, cut length 300 mm

| From | To | Colour | AWG | Signal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| J7-1 | button NO terminal | white | 26 | START (to GND when pressed) |
| J7-2 | button C terminal | black | 26 | ground |
| J7-3 | button LED + terminal | red | 26 | +12 V |
| J7-4 | button LED - terminal | blue | 26 | LED return (switched by Q1) |
